name: Personal Source
subtitle: Apps for SideStore and LiveContainer
description: My personal SideStore source for YTKACE and ArrMatey.

versions.localizedDescription:
by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.47.6
• Action bar editor: reorder buttons and move ⋯ items into the bar
• Added Remove AI Summaries
• Added Avoid Notch Cutoff
• Added an option to disable PiP from the miniplayer
• Added a fullscreen orientation option, and vertical videos stay in portrait
• Added the Open in YTKACE Safari extension
• Remove Products now also hides product rows and cards in feeds, search and the iPad sidebar
• Backups moved to their own page with last backup and size details
• Swipe to Seek shows the preview frame and a bigger scrubber

Fixed:
• Launch hang and crash with Remove Filter Chips on the new Home tabs layout
• Products panel opening on its own
• PiP falling back for free accounts outside the US
• Dislike count on iPhone when Dislike is in the ⋯ menu
• Hold speed pill in right-to-left languages and at 2x
• Blank search with Shorts hidden
• Messages button showing on some tabs
• HLS playback fix not fully applying on newer YouTube versions

YouTube 21.47.6 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.9_YouTube_21.47.6.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.9_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
